notes: Rhythm (scripts/landmarks/de-balie-elevations.json skeleton + research rework 2026-10-10): pale sandstone, two tall storeys over a barred basement, seven window axes: a wide mullioned bay in each stepped-gable wing (surfaces 30/37 and 38/54, 6.3 m) and five bays in the centre (surface 111, 18.8 m) with the arched portal in the middle bay, string course between the storeys, crowning cornice.

Gables, dormers and the steep slate hip roof are the 3DBAG LoD2.2 massing; the wing gables' upper floor lines reach into the gable outline, so an attic window appears where it fits (one per gable in the photo).

The front is slightly bowed in reality; the 3DBAG walls are straight. The basement windows and the portal's pediment are below the component library's grain (portal = recessed entrance with a DE BALIE fascia board as on the photo).
Other walls (Leidseplein side, rear) are blank: no reference photo of them in the skeleton.
